brief.title: KYC onboarding workflow for BrightPath Lending app
business_goals: automated KYC flow that verifies identity documents the moment someone applies
get a decision in real time — ideally under 60 seconds for the straightforward cases
run every applicant against OFAC and other sanctions lists before approval
application must be frozen and routed to a compliance officer, never auto-approved if there's a sanctions hit
both results [Persona & Experian] need to land in the same applicant record so underwriting can see everything in one place
support a manual fallback — if the automated check fails or the confidence score is low, it should route to a human reviewer instead of just rejecting the person outright
Every KYC decision, and the data that led to it, has to be retained for five years to satisfy our regulator during an audit
Address verification should also happen — we need to confirm the address on the ID matches what they entered in the application

stakeholders.name: Sarah Chen
concerns: onboarding is a mess of PDF uploads and manual review, and it takes an average of three days to approve an applicant
We need an automated KYC flow that verifies identity documents the moment someone applies
We're required under the Bank Secrecy Act to run every applicant against OFAC and other sanctions lists before approval
if there's a hit, the application must be frozen and routed to a compliance officer, never auto-approved
Every KYC decision, and the data that led to it, has to be retained for five years to satisfy our regulator during an audit
Last year's exam took our team almost three weeks because records were scattered across six different systems
Address verification should also happen — we need to confirm the address on the ID matches what they entered in the application, since mismatches are one of our biggest fraud signals

stakeholders.name: Marcus Webb
concerns: From the applicant's side, they should be able to upload a driver's license or passport, take a selfie, and get a decision in real time — ideally under 60 seconds for the straightforward cases
Ideally we'd also support a manual fallback — if the automated check fails or the confidence score is low, it should route to a human reviewer instead of just rejecting the person outright
There's also a hard deadline — legal wants this live before our state lending license renewal on March 31st, since the regulator specifically asked about our onboarding controls
Budget for this phase is capped at $250,000, and that has to include the Persona and Experian integration costs

stakeholders.name: Derek Osei
concerns: For document and identity verification we're planning to use Persona, since we already have a contract with them
The system needs to call the Persona API and take their verification result as the source of truth for identity match
We're expecting up to 5,000 applications a day at peak, mostly evenings
The verification pipeline needs to sustain that without falling over — 99.9% uptime is the target we've committed to the board
Honestly the current manual review queue has become a running joke internally, people call it 'the black hole' because applications just sit there for days

stakeholders.name: Jenna Fitzgerald
concerns: We also pull credit data from Experian for the underwriting decision
That's a separate call from Persona, but both results need to land in the same applicant record so underwriting can see everything in one place
re-verification for existing customers who want a second loan is out of scope for this phase

constraints: use Persona for document and identity verification
take Persona's verification result as the source of truth for identity match
required under the Bank Secrecy Act to run every applicant against OFAC and other sanctions lists before approval
pull credit data from Experian for the underwriting decision
Every KYC decision, and the data that led to it, has to be retained for five years
expecting up to 5,000 applications a day at peak
99.9% uptime is the target for the verification pipeline
hard deadline: live before state lending license renewal on March 31st
Budget for this phase is capped at $250,000, including Persona and Experian integration costs
out_of_scope: re-verification for existing customers who want a second loan

epics.title: Automated Identity Verification
epics.goal: To enable applicants to quickly verify their identity through an automated process, ensuring accurate and real-time decisions.

epics.title: Sanctions Compliance & Risk Management
epics.goal: To automatically screen all applicants against sanctions lists and ensure proper handling of any matches to prevent unauthorized approvals.

epics.title: Comprehensive Applicant Data for Underwriting
epics.goal: To consolidate all identity verification and credit data into a single, accessible record for efficient underwriting decisions.

epics.title: Manual Review Workflow
epics.goal: To provide a robust fallback mechanism for applications that cannot be fully processed by the automated KYC system, ensuring no valid applicant is unfairly rejected.

epics.title: Regulatory Data Retention
epics.goal: To ensure all KYC decisions and supporting data are securely retained for the required regulatory period, facilitating audits.

stories.title: Upload Driver's License
stories.so_that: my identity can be automatically verified.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the identity verification screen
acceptance_criteria.when: I upload a valid image of my driver's license
acceptance_criteria.then: the system accepts the upload and I am redirected to the selfie capture screen.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the identity verification screen
acceptance_criteria.when: I upload a file that is not an image (e.g., PDF, DOCX)
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays an error message 'Please upload an image file (JPG, PNG)'.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the identity verification screen
acceptance_criteria.when: I upload an image that is blurry or unreadable
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays a message 'Image is blurry or unreadable. Please re-upload a clearer image.'

stories.title: Upload Passport
stories.so_that: my identity can be automatically verified.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the identity verification screen
acceptance_criteria.when: I upload a valid image of my passport
acceptance_criteria.then: the system accepts the upload and I am redirected to the selfie capture screen.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the identity verification screen
acceptance_criteria.when: I upload a file larger than 10MB
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays an error message 'File size exceeds maximum limit of 10MB'.

stories.title: Take Selfie for Liveness Check
stories.so_that: my liveness can be confirmed as part of identity verification.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the liveness check screen with camera access granted
acceptance_criteria.when: I successfully capture a clear selfie
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays a 'Selfie captured successfully' message and proceeds to document processing.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the liveness check screen
acceptance_criteria.when: I submit a selfie where my face is not clearly visible or is obscured
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays a message 'Face not clearly visible. Please retake your selfie, ensuring your face is centered and well-lit.'

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the liveness check screen
acceptance_criteria.when: I fail to provide a selfie after 3 attempts
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays an option to 'Proceed to Manual Review' or 'Cancel Application'.

stories.title: Integrate with Identity Verification Service
stories.i_want: to send identity document and selfie data to an external verification service
stories.so_that: we can reliably verify applicant identities and receive a trusted identity match decision.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant has submitted their identity documents and selfie
acceptance_criteria.when: the system calls the external identity verification service with the collected data
acceptance_criteria.then: the system receives a verification result (e.g., 'verified', 'unverified', 'review_required') from the identity verification service.

acceptance_criteria.given: the external identity verification service is temporarily unavailable
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts to call the service
acceptance_criteria.then: the system logs the error and routes the application for manual review.

acceptance_criteria.given: the identity verification service returns an 'unverified' result
acceptance_criteria.when: the system receives the service response
acceptance_criteria.then: the application is flagged as 'failed' and routed for manual review.

stories.title: Verify Address Against ID Document
stories.i_want: to compare the address on the uploaded ID with the application address
stories.so_that: we can ensure the applicant's address is valid and consistent with their provided ID.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant's ID document has been processed and an address extracted
acceptance_criteria.when: the extracted ID address exactly matches the address entered in the application
acceptance_criteria.then: the address verification status is marked as 'matched'.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant's ID document has been processed and an address extracted
acceptance_criteria.when: the extracted ID address does not match the address entered in the application
acceptance_criteria.then: the address verification status is marked as 'mismatched' and the application is routed for manual review.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant's ID document does not contain an address
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts address verification
acceptance_criteria.then: the address verification status is marked as 'not applicable' and does not block further processing.

stories.title: Display Real-time KYC Decision
stories.i_want: to receive a real-time KYC decision
stories.so_that: I know immediately if my identity verification is successful.

acceptance_criteria.given: my identity verification is straightforward and successful
acceptance_criteria.when: the automated KYC flow completes
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive a 'verified' decision displayed on screen within 60 seconds.

acceptance_criteria.given: my identity verification requires additional processing (e.g., complex data)
acceptance_criteria.when: the automated KYC flow completes
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive a 'decision pending' message and an estimated wait time or next steps.

acceptance_criteria.given: the Persona API times out or returns an error during verification
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts to get a real-time decision
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays a message 'Identity verification requires manual review. We will contact you within 2 business days.'

stories.title: Screen Applicants Against Sanctions Lists
stories.i_want: to automatically check every applicant against OFAC and other sanctions lists
stories.so_that: we can comply with regulations and avoid approving high-risk applicants.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant submits their information
acceptance_criteria.when: the system performs a sanctions list check
acceptance_criteria.then: the system records a 'no match' result if no sanctions hit is found.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant's name or details match an entry on a sanctions list
acceptance_criteria.when: the system performs a sanctions list check
acceptance_criteria.then: the system records a 'potential match' result.

acceptance_criteria.given: the sanctions list screening service is unavailable
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts to perform a sanctions list check
acceptance_criteria.then: the system logs an error 'Sanctions screening service unavailable' and routes the application to the compliance officer's manual review queue.

stories.title: Route Sanctions Hits to Compliance Officer
stories.i_want: to freeze applications with a sanctions hit and route them to a compliance officer
stories.so_that: we can ensure regulatory compliance and prevent high-risk applicants from being approved automatically.

acceptance_criteria.given: an application has a 'potential match' result from sanctions screening
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes the application
acceptance_criteria.then: the application status is set to 'frozen' and it is added to the compliance officer's review queue.

acceptance_criteria.given: an application has a 'potential match' result from sanctions screening
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts to auto-approve the application
acceptance_criteria.then: the auto-approval process is blocked, and an alert is sent to the compliance team.

acceptance_criteria.given: an application has no sanctions hit
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes the application
acceptance_criteria.then: the application status remains 'In Progress' and it continues through the automated approval workflow.

stories.title: Integrate with Credit Bureau for Credit Data
stories.i_want: to pull credit data from a credit bureau
stories.so_that: I can assess the applicant's creditworthiness.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant has completed identity verification
acceptance_criteria.when: the system calls the credit bureau API with the applicant's details
acceptance_criteria.then: the credit bureau returns the applicant's credit report data.

acceptance_criteria.given: the credit bureau service returns an error or is unavailable
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts to pull credit data
acceptance_criteria.then: the system logs the error and flags the application for manual review.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant has no credit history with the credit bureau
acceptance_criteria.when: the system pulls credit data from the credit bureau
acceptance_criteria.then: the credit bureau returns a 'no record found' response, and this status is recorded.

stories.title: Store All Verification and Credit Data
stories.i_want: to store all identity verification results and credit data in the applicant's record
stories.so_that: I can access all necessary information to make a loan decision and satisfy audit requirements.

acceptance_criteria.given: identity verification results and credit data have been obtained
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes these results
acceptance_criteria.then: all verification and credit data are stored in the applicant's digital record.

acceptance_criteria.given: identity verification results are available but credit data fails to return
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes the available results
acceptance_criteria.then: identity verification results are stored, and the absence of credit data is noted in the applicant's record.

acceptance_criteria.given: data storage fails for an applicant's record
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts to store verification and credit data
acceptance_criteria.then: an error is logged, and the application is flagged for immediate manual intervention.

stories.title: Display Unified Applicant Record for Underwriting
stories.i_want: to view all identity verification and credit results in a single applicant record
stories.so_that: I can make an informed decision quickly.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant has completed KYC and credit checks
acceptance_criteria.when: I access the applicant's record
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays identity verification results, credit data, and sanctions screening results clearly organized on a single screen.

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant's record is missing credit data
acceptance_criteria.when: I access the applicant's record
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays identity verification results and sanctions screening results, with a clear indication that credit data is unavailable.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing an applicant's record
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to different sections of the record
acceptance_criteria.then: the system ensures the displayed verification and credit data remains consistent and accessible across all sections of the record.

stories.title: Route Failed Automated Checks to Manual Review
stories.i_want: to route applications with failed automated checks to a human reviewer
stories.so_that: we can recover applications that encountered technical issues and prevent unnecessary rejections.

acceptance_criteria.given: an automated KYC check (e.g., identity verification service call) fails due to a system error
acceptance_criteria.when: the system detects the failure
acceptance_criteria.then: the application status is updated to 'Manual Review Required' and added to the human reviewer's queue.

acceptance_criteria.given: an automated KYC check fails due to invalid document format
acceptance_criteria.when: the system detects the failure
acceptance_criteria.then: the application status is updated to 'Manual Review Required' and added to the human reviewer's queue.

acceptance_criteria.given: all automated KYC checks pass successfully
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes the application
acceptance_criteria.then: the application proceeds to the next automated step and is not routed for manual review due to automated check failure.

stories.title: Route Low-Confidence Applications to Manual Review
stories.i_want: to route applications with low confidence scores from automated checks to a human reviewer
stories.so_that: we can ensure accurate decisions on borderline applications and reduce false negatives.

acceptance_criteria.given: an automated identity verification service returns a confidence score below a defined threshold (e.g., 70%)
acceptance_criteria.when: the system evaluates the verification result
acceptance_criteria.then: the application status is updated to 'Manual Review Required' and added to the human reviewer's queue.

acceptance_criteria.given: an automated identity verification service returns a confidence score above the defined threshold (e.g., 70%)
acceptance_criteria.when: the system evaluates the verification result
acceptance_criteria.then: the application proceeds through the automated workflow and is not routed for low-confidence manual review.

acceptance_criteria.given: an application is routed for low-confidence manual review
acceptance_criteria.when: a human reviewer accesses the application
acceptance_criteria.then: the confidence score and the reason for routing are clearly displayed within the application record.

stories.title: Retain KYC Decisions and Supporting Data
stories.i_want: to retain every KYC decision and all data that led to it for five years
stories.so_that: BrightPath Lending can satisfy regulatory audit requirements.

acceptance_criteria.given: a KYC decision is made and supporting data is generated
acceptance_criteria.when: the system finalizes the application
acceptance_criteria.then: the KYC decision and all associated data (e.g., identity verification results, credit data, sanctions checks, uploaded documents) are stored and timestamped for a minimum of five years.

acceptance_criteria.given: an audit request is made for an application from three years ago
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized auditor queries the system for the application's KYC data
acceptance_criteria.then: the system retrieves and displays the complete KYC decision and all supporting data.

acceptance_criteria.given: an application's KYC data is five years and one day old
acceptance_criteria.when: the data retention policy is executed
acceptance_criteria.then: the system automatically purges the KYC decision and supporting data, and it is no longer retrievable through standard queries.

gaps.description: The critical non-functional requirements for system performance (R-024: 5,000 applications per day) and availability (R-025: 99.9% uptime) are stated in the brief and requirements, but there are no explicit stories in the backlog addressing the engineering work, architecture, or testing needed to achieve and maintain these targets.
gaps.suggested_question: We have committed to processing 5,000 applications per day and achieving 99.9% uptime (R-024, R-025). What specific stories or architectural tasks are planned to ensure the system meets these performance and availability targets?

gaps.description: Beyond sanctions screening, there are no explicit requirements or stories for general application security, data encryption (at rest/in transit), or robust access controls, which are critical non-functional requirements for a Fintech application handling sensitive personal and financial data.
gaps.suggested_question: Given the sensitive nature of the data handled, what are our explicit security requirements for data encryption, access controls, and overall application security? Are there stories planned to address these foundational security measures?

gaps.description: The definition of 'straightforward cases' in R-007 is not specified, making it difficult to objectively measure compliance with the 60-second decision time.
gaps.suggested_question: How do we define a 'straightforward case' for the 60-second KYC decision time (R-007)? What criteria or conditions would classify an application as straightforward versus complex?

gaps.description: The threshold for a 'low confidence score' in R-021, which triggers manual review, is not defined.
gaps.suggested_question: What is the specific threshold or criteria for a 'low confidence score' (R-021) that will trigger an application to be routed to a human reviewer?

gaps.description: A dedicated operations or support team will be responsible for performing manual reviews (R-019, R-020, R-021) and managing applications with sanctions hits (R-013). Their specific workflow, tools, and training needs are not explicitly represented by a stakeholder.
gaps.suggested_question: Who will be performing the manual reviews and handling sanctions hits? Should we include a representative from the operations or support team as a stakeholder to ensure their workflow and tool needs are addressed?

gaps.coverage_note: The backlog provides good coverage for the core functional requirements of the KYC onboarding workflow, including identity verification, sanctions screening, data consolidation, and the manual fallback process. All explicit business goals from the brief appear to be addressed by at least one requirement and corresponding story. However, there are some critical non-functional aspects and ambiguities that need further attention. Specifically, the backlog does not explicitly address the engineering work required to meet the stated performance and availability targets. There's also a notable absence of general security requirements beyond sanctions screening, which is crucial for a Fintech application handling sensitive data. Finally, some key terms related to decision criteria and operational workflows need clearer definitions to ensure consistent implementation and acceptance. A key operational stakeholder for manual reviews also appears to be missing.
